subject: geom_smooth using Least Absolute Deviation Regression Error

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: geom_smooth using Least Absolute Deviation Regression Error
parts:
library(ggplot2)
library(quantreg)
ggplot(diamonds, aes(x, z)) + geom_point() + ylim(0, 10) + geom_smooth(method = "rq")

results in an error :

Error in summary.rq(object, cov = TRUE, ...) : object 'serr' not found

How can I use least absolute deviation regression, rather than least squares regression, to plot a line of best fit ?

messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: Re: geom_smooth using Least Absolute Deviation Regression Error
parts:
if you can live without standard errors, just use se=FALSE in your
geom_smooth call ...
